item.title: The NYSE Just Took a Big Step Toward Tokenization
item.description: The NYSE is talking about making a “radical” change. Ian King insists it’s further proof of his thesis that tokenization is inevitable.

item.title: Would You Flip a Coin for a Million-Dollar Bet?
item.description: Millions of dollars change hands every day right now. All from seemingly insignificant news. In today’s market, a few simple words can lead to incredible gains for your account. I’m not talking about the Fed’s interest rate decision, or updated comments about inflation… Last Thanksgiving, during the annual presidential turkey pardon, a 26-year-old ex-CPA bet “no” for the words “stuffing” and “cheaper” in the prediction markets.

item.title: The Air Taxi Runway Just Got Shorter
item.description: Ian says a recent move by a large institutional investor suggests that flying taxis could start taking off sooner than expected.

item.title: The Trade Setups Wall Street Won’t Tell You About
item.description: Everyone’s preoccupied with the big names in the market right now: Apple, NVIDIA, Amazon. Blue-chip stocks like these, they’re well-known. Predictable. Boring. And with earnings season, everyone has their eyes on them. Yes, the AI boom has lifted these giants. But there’s a dirty secret that Wall Street doesn’t want you to know about…

item.title: Top Lessons From a Record Trading Month
item.description: It’s early February… There’s still time to get on the right track and flip your account in 2026. For example, one of my most recent millionaire students just cemented a record trading month in January. And a bulk of it came in the final week.

item.title: Why Our Chatbots Are Now Becoming Our Coworkers
item.description: Ian believes the core ingredients for artificial general intelligence are falling into place and beginning to reinforce each other...

item.title: What You Can Learn From The SLV Crash
item.description: One of the wildest momentum swings in modern financial history just happened. It all started when the U.S. dollar lost 30% in 2025. Traders panicked, flooding into precious metals as the obvious dollar hedge.

item.title: Chart of the Week: How AI Is Learning to Stay on the Job
item.description: Ian says AI is starting to behave more like a coworker. And it turns out researchers have been tracking the reason why this is happening.
